title: agentbay.config.yaml
description: Per-project user settings. modes.<name> is validated against that mode's config schema; connectors.<name> against the connector's config schema. Settings can only tighten mode constraints and env limits (strictest wins). Capabilities are bound only in envs/<env>.yaml; there is no config-level binding override.

agent.description: The agent profile (agents/<name>.yaml) that runs every role: how one LLM product maps tiers to models. Default: claude-code.

envs.description: Every role a mode runs in env A runs in env B instead: {A: B}. B must declare `substitutes: A`. Selects between tracked envs; it cannot bind capabilities.
